facts.name: HSBC
sentences: HSBC's shares moved 5% or more on 5 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 3 November 2026, when the stock fell 1.6%.
The stock is up 11.9% this year, and at $88.06 it sits 18.4% below its 52-week closing high of $107.86 from 3 August 2026.
$1,000 invested in HSBC five years ago would be worth $3,003 today.
